title: Status page
tagline: A full status page in plain HTML and Junco's CSS classes, no React
description: A service status page built only with Junco's semantic classes: cards, badges, tables, tooltips, inputs and buttons. It ships as one HTML file and one CSS file, with no client JavaScript except a small theme toggle.
features: Status badges with a dot and a text label, never color alone
90-day uptime bars with hover tooltips, 30 days on phones
Response time table and a subscribe form
Light and dark, remembered across visits
